Synopsis:
GBP is on track to snap a 3-week winning streak ahead of the BoE meeting, pressured by a softer-than-expected UK inflation print and rising Middle East geopolitical risk (oil >$100/bbl). Markets price at least one BoE rate hike, but uncertainty around new PM Andy Burnham's fiscal agenda keeps investors cautious. TD Securities flags the July GBP rally as overdone, with MPC likely on hold.
